name: easyparking
description: A parking management PWA with a React frontend and Express/MongoDB API.

scripts.start: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names backend,frontend "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev -- --host"
scripts.preview: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix frontend run preview -- --host 0.0.0.0
